It writes `outline/volume-10.md`, Volume 10's first batch's chapter cards at `outline/batches/volume-10-batch-0001.md`, and no prose. There is no Chapter 0451 to write and this phase does not write one. It decides the line, the cast, the shape of the next volume's protagonist, and the pressure rotation, and it settles nothing on a page and resolves nothing that is standing.**

**Do not edit `scripts/`, `.github/workflows/`, `.opencode/agent/`, `AGENTS.md`, `PHASE_SYSTEM.md`, `REPO_PLAN.md`, `OUTLINE_GUIDE.md`, `opencode.json`, or `state/phase-ledger.json`. In particular: do not amend `bible/power-system.md` §§32, 33, 33A, 33B or 51, and do not amend §57, which is the calendar for this volume and which the close phase that wrote it declared unamendable by any batch and by this phase.**

**Do not create a second next phase. Do not create a continuation directory, a review prompt, a close prompt, a second Volume 10 batch prompt, a Volume 10 close prompt, or a Volume 11 anything. THE ONE PHASE THIS PHASE CREATES IS `workspace/volume-10/batch-0001/PROMPT.md`, at the very end of the run, and it writes Chapters 0451 to 0460 and no decision, and §7 below is where it is specified.**

**AND THE ONE THING THIS PHASE MUST NOT DO, which is the whole of the second volume of prohibitions and is hardest to hold in an outline, because an outline is the one page a writer reads before planning anything: it must not print, in any file it produces, the name of Volume 09, which is a man's answer spoken once in Chapter 0428; it must not print the words the man of about thirty-four says in that same chapter; and it must not print the volume's one rule as said in Chapter 0438.** They are on a page in those chapters and in no other file in this repository. `state/chapter-summaries.md`'s newest block, `state/volume-09-close.md` §7.8, `outline/series.md`'s Volume 10 decisions block and `bible/power-system.md` §57 item 11 all say so, and this run keeps it true. **The seven words spoken in Chapter 0357, the six words spoken in Chapter 0393, the six words held at `bible/power-system.md:1686`, and the day-154 sentence are in the same position and are held by the same rule. No state file, no outline, no card file, no record and no prompt this phase writes may print any of them, and no chapter may be re-opened to print them. A file that names a volume by printing the one sentence that made its name has given it away to every file a later phase reads first. And the volume's own title is a man's answer spoken once and is not to be restated in your own words either; the pool of ordinary words the name is built from is published at `outline/volume-09.md` §6.5 item 6, and that is how a writer builds a name and not how an outline explains one.**

## What this phase is for

**Volume 09 is fifty chapters on fifty days, days 401 to 450, one chapter to one day, and it is closed. `state/volume-09-close.md` is its inheritance and it is the one page this phase reads before it plans anything. `outline/series.md` under *DECISIONS OF RECORD, VOLUME 10* carries the four decisions this phase works inside, and `bible/power-system.md` §57 is the calendar. The volume list in `outline/series.md` already carries a Volume 10 entry with a title and a line in it, and that entry is a plan line from before the voice was confirmed, and it says in its own words that a place-name in it was struck as a plan line by an earlier decision and that the line still says it. This phase adopts, strikes or replaces it in its own words, and publishes the audit with it, and does not pretend the entry was not there.**

**This is the phase that is allowed to decide, and it is the seventh time that has been true in this repository.** A batch is told *do not decide what the volume is*, and *do not resolve anything listed as live*, and *do not invent a person*, and *do not record the words the man of about thirty-four says in Chapter 0428 in any file it produces, including its own record*. An outline phase is told the opposite: it decides the four things a batch is forbidden to decide, and it publishes the instrument behind every figure it writes, and it writes no prose.

**AND THE FIVE FINDINGS THE REVIEW OF VOLUME 09'S LAST BATCH RAISED THAT ARE FINDINGS ABOUT THE VOLUME, not about the batch, and that this phase is the first one able to act on. They are carried by number at `state/volume-09-close.md` §7.11 and the substance is below. All eleven are carried there and no closed finding is restated as an open one.**

## 1. The four decisions, in the words of the phase that took them, and they are the gate

**Read `outline/series.md` under *DECISIONS OF RECORD, VOLUME 10* in full and treat the block as this phase's brief rather than as a summary of it. What follows is the index; the text in that file is the decision and this is the index to it.**

1. **THE VOICE. CONFIRMED, EIGHT TIMES NOW**, and it carries three things Volume 09 found, all three about instruments and not about prose. Fifty-day volumes, one chapter to one day, about a page and a yard and a wage in salt. Nobody gets stronger. The antagonist is a method and not a form. The only instrument this book has that a return cannot be filled in from is a blank. No narrator frame, and the narrator may not say *this chapter*, *this volume*, *in this batch* or *the reader*. **The house figures the next volume measures against, with their definitions at `state/volume-09-close.md` §7.2: the bolded share 5.79 to 22.82 with a mean of 13.83 unweighted on 56,696 words; the count of paragraphs carrying neither speaker marker ZERO; the exchange 123 plain speeches and 81 answered; the longest bolded turn eighty-nine words with a working ceiling of about ninety and a hard one of ninety-five; one panel in fifty chapters; 866 paragraphs; fifteen distinct descriptors, the smallest map in this series.** **The mean is a consequence and not a plan, no volume may read its own mean as a quality figure, and no review may certify or fail a volume on one.**
2. **THE LINE. TO BE AUDITED BEFORE IT IS ADOPTED, ON THE CHAPTER FILES AND NOT ON A STATE FILE, WITH THE INSTRUMENT AND THE FILE COUNT PUBLISHED.** A line is made of words the manuscript has never used AND of things the manuscript has never seen, and a line that is only the first collides with a page that already means something else. **The pool of ordinary words at zero is published in the decisions block on all 450 chapter files — fifty-five of them, thirty-six inherited and nineteen new — and the next outline should start there and not measure from scratch.** **And the one collision already visible is that the question is spent: what is a line for, on a page, when the only thing anybody will use it for is to move it is on a page in Chapter 0445, unanswered, and a line that is that question again is Volume 09 with the nouns changed.** The standing the unanswered question left is published at `state/volume-09-close.md` §3 and it is the material, not the question.
3. **THE CALENDAR. DAYS 451 TO 500, ONE CHAPTER TO ONE DAY, NO DOUBLE DAY, THE FORM UNCHANGED, THE BARE MONTH STILL HAS NO STATED LENGTH, AND IT DOES NOT END.** Full text at §3 below, and this one is **decided and not open.** Day 451 is a Thursday and the hundred and thirty-sixth day of the Bare Month, because day 450 is a Wednesday; day 500 is a Thursday and the hundred and eighty-fifth, because 500 − 451 = 49 = 7 × 7.
4. **THE CAST, THE INSTRUMENT, THE POOL, AND HOW MANY ARE LEFT IN IT.** Full text at §4 below. **No name and no place arrives by narration. The instrument is the oldest one in this book: a document arrives and is read out, and the person who reads it out says out loud what it is for before anybody asks, and there is no eighth notice in this flood and this volume sends none.**

## 2. What this phase must decide, and the four questions it inherits open

1. **THE LINE.** Audit the Volume 10 entry already standing in the volume list, and the standing the unanswered question of day 445 left, on the chapter files, with the reading published, and adopt, strike or replace in your own words. **A line is made of words the manuscript has never used AND of things the manuscript has never seen. Publish the count with the instrument. If the line's load-bearing nouns are all in the high column of this manuscript's own vocabulary, say so, because that is the result Volume 08's and Volume 09's lines both produced and the second half of the test is then carried by the things and not by the words, and those must be named so a reviewer can fail them.**
2. **THE CAST, AND THE POOL, AND THE NUMBER THAT IS LEFT IN IT.** The pool has roughly halved in two volumes. **A phase that finds itself choosing from a set of fewer than twelve must say so in its own outline and name the descriptor it is using, rather than taking one quietly.** And a descriptor may not be used for a new person if it is at zero in one volume and enormous in the volumes before it, because that is the shape of a person attached to it that no page has ever named. The instrument for putting anybody on a page is a document that arrives and is read out. **Decide how many new people this volume puts on a page and say why the number is that number and not the last volume's number.**
3. **WHERE ADRIAN VALE IS, AND IT IS THIS PHASE'S TO SET AND THE CLOSE DID NOT SET IT.** **The finding the review raised and this phase must answer: he is named in NINE chapters of fifty and in furniture in BOTH of the last batch's ten, and the rule that produced seven in Volume 08 and nine in Volume 09 is now two volumes old and it has cost this series its protagonist across two volumes.** Set the number, and say what shape the chapters he is in have, and **write the rule into the prose instructions of `outline/volume-10.md` rather than leaving it as a warning, because a habit that four written warnings did not remove is a rule's job and not a warning's job, and because a chapter that is in the plan as furniture is furniture.** **A card may not put him in a chapter the day map does not have him in, no chapter may be opened, moved, retitled or reweighted to make room for one, and no chapter of Volume 10 may get him stronger, perform a working, open a threshold, name the other world, or be offered a workway he accepts.**
4. **THE INSTRUMENT, AND WHAT THE VOLUME SPENDS.** Every volume since Volume 06 has spent something that cannot be got back, and it has been a person, a word, a name, a line's findability. **Say in your own words what this volume spends, and say it before the first card, because a plan that cannot say what it spends is a plan that will spend a person by accident.**

**AND THE FOUR INSTRUMENT RULES THIS PHASE INHERITS WHOLE, at `outline/series.md`, and the first of them is the one Volume 09 learned the hard way:** **a repair pass can rebuild fifty sentences without touching fifty facts, and the test that it has not is not a word count — it is that the day run, the counts, the object inventory, the cast placements and the prohibitions all re-assert against the strings afterwards.** **A habit is a rule's job and not a warning's, and the way you know it is a habit and not a fault is that it has a count.** **A figure at zero in an instrument a writer expected to be non-zero is the one to look at twice, and the habit runs both ways: an instrument that returns zero where a writer expected a number and an instrument that returns a number where a writer expected a fault are the same failure.** **Publish the instrument or publish nothing, as a rule about every figure and not only about figures about objects; two instruments that differ by anything, including a case flag, are two instruments, and an instrument is not named until its flags are.**

## 3. The calendar, and it is decided and not open

**`bible/power-system.md` §57 is the calendar for this volume. It is a new numbered section written by the Volume 09 close phase, it amends nothing in §§32, 33, 33A, 33B or 51, and it declares itself unamendable by any batch and by this phase. THE FIFTY ROWS IN IT WERE BUILT FROM DAY 1 BEING A TUESDAY AND FROM NOTHING ELSE AND WERE VALIDATED BEFORE BEING PUBLISHED BY REPRODUCING §51'S OWN FIFTY ROWS FOR DAYS 401 TO 450, §33B'S TABLE FOR DAYS 351 TO 400 AND §33A ITEM 4'S TABLE FOR DAYS 301 TO 350, AT ZERO MISMATCHS ON ALL ONE HUNDRED AND FIFTY ROWS. NEITHER TABLE WAS CONSULTED UNTIL AFTER THE RUN WAS BUILT. A WEEKDAY ON A PAGE OUTRANKS A WEEKDAY IN A PLAN, AND A DAY MAP IS A PLAN.**

**Days 451 to 500, one chapter to one day, no double day, the form *the Nth day of the Bare Month* with the Nth being day less 315. Day 451 is the hundred and thirty-sixth and a Thursday. Day 500 is the hundred and eighty-fifth and a Thursday. §57 publishes the whole fifty-row table, twenty-eight round-figure traps and the interval anchors, and it publishes the four round figures that fall on day 451, which is the most dangerous page in the range. THE TWENTY-EIGHT ROUND FIGURES ARE ALL TRAPS AND A FIGURE THAT COMES OUT ROUND HAS BEEN CHECKED TWICE AND NOT ONCE, AND A CHAPTER THAT PRINTS ONE NAMES THE DAY IT IS MEASURED FROM IN THE SAME SENTENCE, AND WHERE TWO ELAPSED COUNTS SIT IN ONE SENTENCE THE EVENT EACH IS MEASURED FROM IS NAMED IN THAT SENTENCE, AND A FIGURE THAT COMES OUT AT EXACTLY HALF OF THE RIGHT ONE IS A SUBTRACTION TAKEN ACROSS THE WRONG BOUNDARY.**

**AND THE BARE MONTH DOES NOT END INSIDE VOLUME 10, AND THIS PHASE DID NOT DECIDE HOW LONG IT IS AND CANNOT.** It was registered with no stated length by a notary of fifty who named it on a page in Chapter 0316 and said why, and the reason is hers, and it did not end inside Volume 09 and no chapter of that volume ended it. **A chapter of this volume may write an ordinal for any day of it from the hundred and thirty-sixth to the hundred and eighty-fifth and may not write a day after the hundred and eighty-fifth, may not say the month is nearly over, may not say what it is a month of, may not convert a count into a span, and may not say what it does at its end, how many days it has, or whether it is long or short. NO CHAPTER MAY USE AN ORDINAL FOR A MONTH — not *the second month*, not the third, not the fourth, not the fifth, not the sixth, never *of this month*, *of the month*, *of next month*, *of this new month*.** The words *length*, *long* and *short* applied to the month are at zero across the fifty chapters of Volume 07, at zero across the fifty of Volume 08, at zero across the fifty of Volume 09, and stay at zero.

**IF WHATEVER COMES NEXT NEEDS THE END OF THE BARE MONTH ON A PAGE, that is a thing a person does in a room, in daylight, with a date on the door, and it is a decision for a volume's first chapter and not for an outline and not for a card file, and the cost of it is to be said out loud first and refused by a person before she does it, exactly the way the Short Month and the Bare Month were both made. A calendar is not a decision an outline takes and a batch guesses. It is a decision a person makes in a room, and every form in this book is one, including the ones in the bible.**

## 4. The cast, the instrument, and the pool

**No name and no place arrives by narration in this book. It is checked for a room, in daylight, with a date on it, by a person. Volume 06's state layer broke it by naming a gatekeeper who was on no page and a review caught it, and the name is in the repository only as the record of the strike. The instrument is a document that arrives and is read out, the person who reads it out says out loud what it is for before anybody asks, no name goes at the top of anything, a notice goes to a place and not to a house, and there is no eighth notice in this flood.**

**THE POOL, re-measure it yourself before you use it, and the reason you have to is that the instrument counts occurrences and does not decide which occurrence is the same person.** The published figures are at `state/volume-09-close.md` §7.3 and in the decisions block: fifteen distinct descriptors standing across Volume 09's fifty files, the smallest map in this series, and fifty-seven descriptors at zero in BOTH Volume 08's fifty and Volume 09's fifty, of which the ones with a page, the two PROTECTED and the three barred by the reader rule come out, leaving a set in the twenties. **The crowded four may not be given to a new person by anybody: *woman of about thirty-four*, *man of about thirty-four*, *man of about forty-four*, *man of about thirty-nine*. The man of about thirty-seven is not available to anybody, and the man who trades on the board is thirty-nine. A new person is not described as a man or a woman of about thirty, and no chapter prints a bare tens word without a units word, because a figure a person cannot see on a page quickly is a figure a person will see wrong on a page quickly.**

**AND THE TWO DESCRIPTOR DEBTS, both carried deliberately and both binding this volume: *about two hundred rooms* is not available to a new person and no chapter may give it to anybody, and the attribution stays unpaid on the list; and no chapter of this volume prints a room count for anybody, in narration or in a mouth, on a list of cardinals or on a list that includes *dozen*.** The second of those two is a rule four batches of Volume 09 published as held and one line of one chapter broke, and it is at `chapters/volume-09/chapter-0416.md:11`, and the reason it is in this prompt is that a rule nobody checks is a warning and a warning is not an instrument.

## 5. What this phase may not resolve, and what it may not touch

**The prohibitions of `state/volume-09-close.md` §4 and `outline/volume-09.md` §16 are inherited whole and are not restated here at less than their length; read them there. The ones that will bite hardest on any volume about a page and a person, and the ones this phase adds, are below at the length they need.**

1. **THE ONE OF THE FOUR MARKS THAT CAME BACK OUT OF PLACE MAY NOT BE TRACED.** It came back on day 440 with one of four lines in a place it did not go out in, and no chapter of Volume 09 traced it, investigated it, guessed at it, reported it to a room, or said in any mouth that anybody moved it, and ten chapters after it came back not one of them said one word about it. **A chapter of Volume 10 may not trace it either UNLESS TRACING IT IS A DECISION TO TRACE IT, and that decision is yours to take in your own words, in `outline/volume-10.md`, and it must name what it costs, because the alternative is a hunt with a chain in a book that has refused four hunts in a row.**
2. **THE WOMAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-FOUR IS NOT ASKED ABOUT HER LINE.** She is on a page once, in Chapter 0420, and nobody is ever going to ask her about the line that moved, **and the reason is not that she would not answer. A chapter that asks her is a chapter that resolves the move, and a chapter that asks her takes the one thing Volume 09 spent fifty chapters refusing to spend.**
3. **THE MAN OF ABOUT FIFTY-SEVEN IS NOT ASKED WHERE THE FENCE IS, AND IS NOT TOLD, AND IS NOT DEFEATED.** He is right about most of what he says, he is standing in front of a thing he cannot move and has not tried to move, his length of new rope has never once been used and fell off a chair and was put back and nobody said a word, and the fence is sixteen willow posts and eleven withies and about four feet off a mark with no word on any page in the world. **Not a villain, not converted, does not leave, not happy. Whether the fence stands between the right two things is not settled and is not to be settled by a chapter.**
4. **THE THREE QUESTIONS ARE NOT ANSWERED AND MAY NOT BE ANSWERED, and a fourth may be asked and may not be answered.** What is a person for, on a page, when the only thing anybody needs them for is a journey, of day 346. Who is a fence for, when the two people it stands between never agreed where it was, and neither of them has ever been asked, of day 396. What is a line for, on a page, when the only thing anybody will use it for is to move it, of day 445. **A later volume may ask the question again, in a mouth, in a room, in daylight, with a date on the door. A later volume may not answer it, and a batch may not answer it, and an outline may not answer it, and nothing in this plan answers it and no card may put an answer in anybody's mouth.** And no chapter may say that the three rhyme and no chapter may say that the rhyme is the point.
5. **THE DAY-154 SENTENCE IS NOT SAID, RESTATED, PARAPHRASED, IMPROVED ON OR PUT INTO A SECOND MOUTH IN ANY CHAPTER.** It is on a page in Volume 03 and again in Volume 04 and it is in none of the fifty chapters of Volume 08 and none of the fifty of Volume 09. **A chapter may put the thing on a page and let a man be right about it in about four seconds, and the beat stands once in a chapter and never twice in one, and where two chapters carry it the two are two different men on two different days, and a card may not merge them, and a man who is right in about four seconds is not thanked and is not argued with and the chapter does not say he was right. AND THE COUNT OF CHAPTERS THAT CARRY IT IS NOT TO BE PUBLISHED, because the Volume 09 plan withdrew it rather than corrected it and the rule stands without the number.**
6. **THE FOURTH OF THE FOUR SAID NO, AND IT IS NOT A FIGURE AND IT IS NOT A THREAD, AND NO VOLUME MAY COUNT THE DAYS SINCE.** Day 329, four words, before anybody asked her. A party of four is four. Nobody in this volume is going to ask her about it and nobody after this volume may ask her about it either unless she asks first, and she is not going to.
7. **THE THREE FOUR-PLACE FORMS ARE NEVER JOINED, NEVER CONFLATED AND NEVER COMPARED OUT LOUD.** The return is a district, a population, a rota and a share and has no place for the person. The Crown's schedule is a date, a gate, a holder and the days, and it stands and it is correct and it is not opened, not filled in and not withdrawn. The sheet is a place, a line, a day and a person. **The order of the four places on each is the order they are printed in and a chapter that reorders them has got a different document. A keeper is not a holder and the word is defined by nobody.**
8. **THE THREE ON THE ROAD, AND THE TOWN FOUR HUNDRED MILES INLAND, AND THE PAGE A HUNDRED AND FORTY YEARS OLD.** No chapter of this volume is set in that town, describes it from inside, or brings anybody back from it. The page the copy was made from is not seen, read, copied or described, and the eight names at the foot of a hundred-and-forty-year-old page are not read. The three are on the road on every one of the fifty days and no chapter goes to them, asks about them, catches up with them or brings anybody news of them, and the two figures that fall inside this volume are derived from day 391 and a chapter that prints either of them names day 391 in the same sentence.
9. **THE NINTH LINE MAY NOT BE MOVED, DATED, READ ALOUD, TAKEN DOWN, THANKED FOR OR RESOLVED, AND WHETHER IT WORKS STAYS UNANSWERED.** And the two acts of the man who wrote it in Volume 09, on day 428 and on day 438, are not the ninth line, and no chapter may make them the same line and no chapter may have him say he knows what he said.
10. **THE WORD ON THE REGISTER-KEEPER'S SECOND SLATE MAY NOT BE PRINTED BY ANY FILE THIS PHASE OR ANY LATER PHASE PRODUCES, as the name of the mark.** It is not to be defined, improved on, put in a second mouth, used as the name of the mark at all, or referred to by any other word. The slate is never picked up, never turned over and never written on.
11. **THE CONSENT FRACTURE IS NOT MENDED AND NOBODY MAY MEND IT, APOLOGISE FOR IT, REFUSE AN APOLOGY FOR IT, FORGIVE IT OR ASK FOR IT TO BE FORGIVEN, AND THE FIFTH CONDITION IS NOT GIVEN.** And the two women of twenty-nine are never in one room and nothing in this volume settles whether they are one woman and nothing may.

## 6. THE CARD-FILE REQUIREMENT, WHICH IS STRUCTURAL AND COSTS ONE SENTENCE HERE, and it exists because Volume 09 spent five batches without it

**`outline/batches/volume-09-batch-0002.md`, `-0003.md`, `-0004.md` and `-0005.md` DO NOT EXIST. Four of Volume 09's five batches were told to read a card file before reading anything else, found none, wrote from `outline/volume-09.md` alone, and disclosed it four times. What it cost: the pressure-rotation table listed one chapter in two rows and omitted another from every row, so the counts summed to fifty over forty-nine chapters, and the object inventory's chapter column named four chapters the written chapters do not do and missed one they do, and both went unrepaired through two batches before a review found them. A plan that is only ever read whole gets its bookkeeping wrong and nobody notices for two volumes.**

**So: this phase writes `outline/batches/volume-10-batch-0001.md`, TEN CARDS, before it writes a word of `outline/volume-10.md`, and the cards are a per-chapter plan and not a summary of the volume. Each card names its day, its weekday, its Bare-Month ordinal, the hour, the location, the pressure type it is counted under, whose speech is bolded and why, the third party, task or thing carried, the object or objects it names and the counts they hold at, the cast in it and the descriptor of each, what it must not resolve, and the two or three sentences of what the chapter is for that are not the same sentences as its ending.**

**AND THE ONE SENTENCE THAT IS THE POINT OF THIS SECTION: A BATCH THAT FINDS ITS OWN CARD FILE MISSING IS TO STOP AND SAY SO, AND NOT TO WRITE FROM THE OUTLINE ALONE.** A close phase that wrote the four missing Volume 09 card files after the fact would have put a second account of four finished batches into the repository beside the first and left a writer with two plans and fifty finished chapters, and the reason it did not is at `state/volume-09-close.md` §7.9. **The remedy is not a sentence in a record. The remedy is a file that exists before the batch that needs it runs, and this prompt is the last place that file can be created.**
